paragraphs.source_en: “I . . .” She looked anguished. “Yes—yes, I’m staying. Ron, we said we’d go with Harry, we said we’d help—”

units.source_en: She looked anguished.
“Yes—yes, I’m staying.
Ron, we said we’d go with Harry, we said we’d help—”
“I get it.
You choose him.”
“Ron, no—please—come back, come back!”

paragraphs.source_en: She was impeded by her own Shield Charm; by the time she had removed it he had already stormed into the night. Harry stood quite still and silent, listening to her sobbing and calling Ron’s name amongst the trees.

units.source_en: She was impeded by her own Shield Charm; by the time she had removed it he had already stormed into the night.
Harry stood quite still and silent, listening to her sobbing and calling Ron’s name amongst the trees.

paragraphs.source_en: After a few minutes she returned, her sopping hair plastered to her face.

units.source_en: After a few minutes she returned, her sopping hair plastered to her face.
“He’s g-g-gone!
Disapparated!”

paragraphs.source_en: She threw herself into a chair, curled up, and started to cry.

units.source_en: She threw herself into a chair, curled up, and started to cry.

paragraphs.source_en: Harry felt dazed. He stooped, picked up the Horcrux, and placed it around his own neck. He dragged blankets off Ron’s bunk and threw them over Hermione. Then he climbed onto his own bed and stared up at the dark canvas roof, listening to the pounding of the rain.
